fusions.name: Sealed in the Cell
fusions.desc: Stings every enemy within 3 tiles. Each sting deals 10 damage, stuns its target for 1 second and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Egg Laid Last
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. A sting that deals 16 damage, leaves the target [Pinned] for 4 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stilled for the Egg
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds and leaves each one [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hatching Day
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs out on an enemy, a stinger leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
